_source: Each entry is a claim our profile (gdl/designsys/turbulence.json) or its README made that Turbulence's own pages contradict, found by the grammar measurement of 2026-10-22: every page and popup of seeds/Turbulence 1035.gdl, 725, 1525, 720, 525 and 320, read with gdl.project (each control's rect, look, caption and font) beside its renders; and turbulence-35 by measuring every source popup's picture in the same seeds (tests/measure_series.py _pictures). `template` is what those pages do, off the seed and pages named; the region frame (panels[series].frame) is the same seeds measured by tests/measure_series.py frame_of. `python -m gdl.designsys audit turbulence` checks every resolution against the profile, the README and the frame as they stand.
